question: A couple with a first male child (index case) affected by cystic fibrosis (mucoviscidosis) goes to the genetic counseling clinic. The molecular diagnosis indicates that the index case is homozygous for the F508del mutation and its heterozygous carrier parents. The clinical geneticist will inform you about the form of transmission of the disease. Which statement is correct?

options.opa: The probability that the next descendant is affected is 25%.
options.opb: The probability that the next descendant is affected is 50%.
options.opc: Having had an affectionate child, the next descendant will also be affectionate.
options.opd: Having had a homozygous F508del son, the next descendant will be a heterozygous carrier (67%) or a homozygous genotype without the mutation (33%).
